'''Snoozer''' was watching when {{Player|HarlsoM|flag=au}} and his mitten gloves won a tournament Sylvania, Sydney hosted by the 'deathNET lan group' in [[1997]]. After that he thought "I have to play this game." 
Snoozer is an Australian [[Team Fortress|QWTF]] player masquerading as a QWDM player.  He spent most of his time over the last 23 years playing QWTF, however occasional QWDM with his friends {{Player|greyseer|flag=au}} and {{Player|ABC|flag=au}}. 

Recently he has found the active Australian QW community on discord and is enjoying the banter and open acceptance for all skill levels.  He still misses his Software Quakeworld [[:Category:Clients|client]].

====Play Style====
After getting over the shock of not spawning with a stack and weapons, zzz had to adjust his play style to avoid shooting walls, less +forward, and start to develop item control, and timing.
He still he has a hard time not shooting walls and teammates as well as generally remembering what all the areas are called in maps, however is enjoying the journey.

==Trivia==
Snoozer likes his coffee black and teaches martial arts for a living. (that’s why he never answers your messages for 4’s on weeknights Swoop)  He has a competitive nature and dislikes all other FPS because they are all too slow.
